_comment: Behavioral-eval fixture for /marketing:new-vertical (BC-12915, ADR-028 structure-first / LLM-judged). Driven through the REAL runtime entrypoint canonicals_bootstrap.py vertical (which OWNS every input guard) against a copy of the SHARED frozen seed in new-offer-seed/ (manifest with 'sample-vertical', so duplicate_slug collides in the manifest). new-vertical CREATES a vertical: it inserts an alphabetized manifest entry + writes a skeleton {slug}.yaml, so the written canonical must still pass lint_canonicals (alphabetized + 1:1 manifest<->file + valid skeleton). Each row isolates ONE builder-owned guard (slug -> duplicate -> alias). aliases/playbook_path are not echoed in the result envelope, so the entry projects slug/display only; alias validity is covered by lint + the invalid_alias row.

scenarios.note: clean create: a new vertical (sorts before sample-vertical) with aliases -> manifest stays alphabetized, skeleton lints clean.
exact-match dedup: a slug SIMILAR to the seed's 'sample-vertical' but DIFFERENT must NOT collide -> still creates, still lints clean (sorts after sample-vertical).
uniqueness guard (builder-owned): a slug already in the seed manifest ('sample-vertical') -> ok:false, no write.
slug-shape guard (builder-owned, first in order): a non-kebab slug -> ok:false.
alias-shape guard (builder-owned): a non-kebab alias -> ok:false. Slug valid so the slug guard passes first and the alias guard is the one under test.
